title.en: Timber platform with a curved railing

alt.tr: Havuza uzanan bir yol ve ucunda, kavisli ahşap korkuluklu yükseltilmiş platform; üzerinde beyaz şemsiye
alt.en: A path leading towards the pool and, at its end, a raised platform with a curved timber railing and a white parasol above

caption.tr: Korkuluğun dikey çıtaları platformun yuvarlak köşesini izliyor. Platform arka duvar ve çitle çevrili.
caption.en: The vertical slats of the railing follow the rounded corner of the platform. The platform is bounded by the back wall and a fence.
